# dev commands

Every `dev` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `dev:capability-index:build`

Regenerate the shipped index of capabilities across every Semitexa package (run in the monorepo).

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:capability-index:build
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--check` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:capabilities`

List all available generator and introspection commands with inputs, outputs, and usage guidance

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:capabilities
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:event`

Show all listeners for a given event, or list all events with their listener count

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:event
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--name` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:mechanisms`

List what the installed framework can do — deferred rendering, components, live transport, UI behaviors — with when to use and when not to.

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:mechanisms
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--id` | yes |
| `--area` | yes |
| `--state` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:mine-conventions`

Walk the codebase and persist per-module conventions used by convention-aware scaffolders

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:mine-conventions
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--module` | yes |

## `dev:graph:module`

Show module structure: routes, handlers, services, contracts, listeners

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:module
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--name` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:path`

Explain a file/directory path using global module-structure rules + package-local extension (if any)

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:path
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--path` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:project`

Show project overview: modules, routes, contracts, listeners

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:project
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `dev:graph:route`

Show the full chain for a route: payload → handler → resource → template → auth

```bash
bin/semitexa dev:graph:route
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--path` | yes |
| `--method` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
